questions.question: I’ve been turning over how Ashley’s dread about the consciousness transfer contrasts with the way Horizon and Murky are manually patching that runaway crystal subroutine in their starship’s drive. While she’s disconnecting from the network to chase down vanished research archives, they’re relying on ancient coding logic to keep their vessel from burning itself out during the journey. It’s wild that the same underlying system governing magical engines and digital minds seems to dictate everything from global data erosion to the roadmap for actually stepping into the simulation. I keep wondering how the actual transition feels once you’re seated and ready, especially since the documentation implies your choices afterward are completely fixed. Once you finally say the required words, exactly how many seconds does the irreversible transfer sequence run before the robotic arms drag you back?
